description: Henter revisjonshandlingene på én eksplisitt oppdrags-ID. Svaret har alltid en eksakt oppsummering per revisjonsområde: antall, utført, i arbeid, ikke aktuell og gjennomgått, for delår og årsslutt hver for seg, planlagte forslag som venter, og områdesignering. Områder med arbeidspapir telles fra arbeidspapiret, ellers fra de eldre handlingene, som i områdeoversikten. Oppgi omraade for å få handlingene i ett område: status, om den er utført og gjennomgått med dato, handlingstype, bevismetode, påstander og ISA-nummer, høyst 100 handlinger og 30 forslag. Handlingstekst, notater, konklusjoner, begrunnelser og hvem som har utført eller signert er utelatt. Et område uten handlinger betyr «ingen registrert», aldri «ferdig». Dette er arbeidsstatus, ikke en faglig godkjenning.

omraade.description: Områdekode fra per_omraade, for eksempel S for salg. Utelat for bare oppsummeringen.

oppdrag_id.description: Eksplisitt oppdrags-ID fra Revly. Oppslag uten ID er ikke tillatt.

name: hent_handlinger

outputSchema.description: Audit procedures of one engagement. Work status only, not a professional approval.

detalj_antall.description: Procedures in the requested area; more than the rows returned when truncated.

anyOf.description: Minimal evidence that this read was recorded.

client_receipt.description: Whether the connected client confirmed receipt. Revly reports "unknown".

result_produced.description: True when Revly produced the read result.

aksept_status.description: Legacy: aktiv, or utkast for a proposal not yet accepted.

bevismetode.description: Evidence method from the procedure library, for example analytisk or detaljtest. Null when not linked.

gjennomgaatt.description: Workpaper: an active review sign-off exists.

handlingstype.description: Legacy type: risikovurdering, kontrolltest or substans. Null means not classified, never substantive.

isa.description: ISA standard numbers found in the reference, as written there. Null when none.

kilde.description: Legacy: from the library, an AI proposal or entered manually.

ledd_ref.description: Workpaper: the procedure key in the area template.

paastander.description: Assertion codes as single letters, for example «E, F». Null when missing or not a code list.

status.description: Workpaper status code, for example ikke_startet, i_arbeid, signert or ikke_aktuell.

utfoert.description: Performed. Workpaper: an active performed sign-off or status signert. Legacy: marked performed.

utfoert_dato.description: Date performed, Norwegian time, as YYYY-MM-DD.

utfoert_signert.description: Workpaper: an active performed sign-off exists.

vindu.description: Workpaper: execution window, interim or year-end.

handlinger.description: Procedures of the requested area, at most 100. Null when no area was requested.

missing_sources.description: Sources with no record. Missing data stays visible and is never treated as a positive result.

omraade.description: The area the procedure rows belong to, when one was requested.

operation_id.description: Revly operation ID for this read, recorded in the access log.

antall.description: Procedures in the window. Zero means none registered, never done.
Procedures in the window. Zero means none registered, never done.

arbeidspapir.description: Workpaper counts per window. The windows are separate and must not be added up as one season.

kilde_modell.description: Which model the counts come from: arbeidspapir when the area has workpaper procedures, else legacy, as the area overview.

antall.description: Accepted procedures. Rejected proposals are not counted.

utkast_ikke_akseptert.description: Proposals not yet accepted, counted apart.

legacy.description: Legacy counts, when the area has no workpaper procedures.

omraade_signert.description: Area sign-off types registered. Empty means none registered.

planlagt_venter.description: Proposed procedures waiting for the auditor.

per_omraade.description: Exact roll-up per audit area over every procedure, never cut.

fra_bibliotek.description: Whether the proposal comes from the procedure library.

har_risiko_kobling.description: Whether the proposal is linked to a risk.

isa.description: ISA standard numbers found in the reference, as written there. Null when none.

paastander.description: Assertion codes as single letters, for example «E, F». Null when missing or not a code list.

planlagte_handlinger.description: Proposed procedures in the requested area waiting for the auditor, at most 30.

revly_url.description: Link to the engagement in Revly.

items.description: Source manifest entry: what contributed to the result and how current it is.

group_count.description: Grouped signature rows, for grouped sources.

source.description: Source that contributed to the result, for example oppdrag+klienter or forespoersler.

version.description: Latest version marker as text. Null when Revly has no version.

sources.description: Sources that contributed to the result.

truncated.description: True when the procedure rows or proposals were cut at their bound. The roll-up is never cut.
